Second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values: the dominant strategy is to bid my true value to maximize expected profit. There’s only one round and no history to exploit, so no strategic shading or signaling helps. With value $20, bidding 20 wins whenever rivals’ top bid is below 20 and pays the second-highest bid, guaranteeing nonnegative profit when winning and zero otherwise. This maximizes long-run expected profit under these rules.
